newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pediatrix Medical Group.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pediatrix Medical Group.

text.p: --Montgomery Securities analyst Amy de Rham said she initiated coverage of Pediatrix Medical Group Inc with a buy rating.
--She said she expects the company to earn $0.89 per share in fiscal 1996 and $1.17 in fiscal 1997. Her target prices is $59 or about 23 percent above current levels.
--Pediatrix Medical Group provides physician management services to hospital-based neonatal intensive care units.
